name: Cell Therapy Orchestration
one_liner: Chain of identity and custody from apheresis slot booking to infusion, across treatment sites, manufacturing and couriers.
fits_when: an autologous cell or gene therapy is made per patient and must carry one chain-of-identity ID end to end
treatment sites request apheresis slots against limited manufacturing capacity
manufacturing batches move through production, QC and release before shipping back to the site
couriers must log every pickup, handover and receipt as a custody event
the treatment site confirms receipt and infusion with a COI check at the bedside
different parties (sites, apheresis units, couriers) may only see their own patients and shipments
gives_you: Patient record keyed by a chain-of-identity (COI) ID, with a COI 360 page and printable label
Slot requests with capacity-checked confirmation, waitlisting and cancellation
Batch lifecycle from awaiting material to QC and release, with certificate of analysis
Inbound and outbound shipments with courier pickup, transit, delivery and receipt
A custody log of every handoff with COI verification and temperature status
Row-level access so sites, apheresis centres and couriers see only their own records

catalogue.description: Vein-to-vein orchestration for autologous cell therapies. Treatment sites enrol patients under a chain-of-identity ID and request apheresis slots, the manufacturing scheduler confirms capacity and runs each batch to release, couriers log every custody handoff, and the site confirms receipt and infusion. Every record and screen carries the COI ID.

roles.name: Site coordinator
roles.description: Enrols patients, requests slots, receives the product and confirms infusion for their own site

roles.name: Apheresis center
roles.description: Sees its schedule, confirms collection against the COI and hands material to the courier

roles.name: Manufacturing scheduler
roles.description: Allocates capacity, confirms slots, runs batches through QC and release, and books shipments

roles.name: Courier
roles.description: Sees only its own shipments and logs pickup, transit, delivery and every custody event

compliance: Chain of identity: one COI ID on every record, label and handoff, verified at collection, receipt and infusion
Chain of custody: every handover logged with who, where, when and temperature status
Patient name stays at the treatment site; other parties see only COI and initials
Role-scoped access for sites, apheresis centres and couriers
Audit trail of every transition, aligned to GxP and 21 CFR Part 11 expectations
